principle.name: GUARD_CRUMPLE_WAVE_REBASE
principle.statement: A single early guard contact absorbs pressure through a visible distal-to-proximal compliance wave before support is allowed to break; contact then releases, the old lead foot peels and rebases under the displaced COM, and guard readiness returns only after rear-load overshoot and counter-torque are paid.
principle.novelty_boundary: Distinct from Defense007-021: no wall/tool/body post/custody handoff/contact migration/airborne void/fixed-foot heel roll/roof shear occurs. The decisive mechanism is SAME-JOINT guard contact followed by a serial forearm→shoulder/rib→pelvis compression wave, then post-release unilateral support peel/rebase and late readiness.

observed: whole-sheet coexistence of neutral/travel/hit/fall/recovery and explicit doing/receiving contact families

rights.notes: Commercial sprite sheet is evidence only. Output is an independent abstract ASCII rig; no source pixels, palette, costume, contours, layout, tracing, choreography, redistribution, or source audio.

keys.name: OFFSET_READY
keys.causal_role: offset guard and stance expose the incoming midline pressure before response
keys.motion_arc_root_note: COM is centered but slightly rear-biased; both feet own floor

keys.name: ANTICIPATION_FRAME
keys.causal_role: lead forearm rises and body pre-compresses before impact; contact is not yet claimed
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis sits back while both supports remain explicit

keys.name: EARLY_FOREARM_CATCH
keys.causal_role: first contact is authored before maximum displacement and stays assigned to the same guard joint
keys.motion_arc_root_note: contact begins while both feet still own floor and the torso has not yet collapsed

keys.name: DISTAL_CRUMPLE
keys.causal_role: forearm and elbow fold first while the contact joint remains the same
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root trails the distal collapse; feet remain planted because support debt has not reached the base

keys.name: SHOULDER_RIB_WAVE
keys.causal_role: compression arrives at shoulder and ribcage after the distal fold; silhouette narrows and tilts under load
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis follows late and down-right; floor ownership still bilateral

keys.name: PELVIS_BACKLOAD_LEAD_UNLOAD
keys.causal_role: the same guard contact now loads the pelvis; only after the proximal wave arrives does the old lead heel unload
keys.motion_arc_root_note: COM is visibly rear/right of the lead foot and right leg owns most pressure

keys.name: RELEASE_THEN_LEAD_PEEL
keys.causal_role: contact topology ends before the lead support leaves; the old lead foot peels only after release
keys.motion_arc_root_note: right foot becomes sole support while the left foot visibly clears the floor

keys.name: REAR_LOAD_OVERSHOOT
keys.causal_role: root and torso continue rearward after contact is gone instead of springing back
keys.motion_arc_root_note: single right support swallows the remaining impulse while the free lead leg trails

keys.name: LEAD_REBASE_PREPLANT
keys.causal_role: free lead foot travels under the displaced COM but is not allowed to own support before reaching floor
keys.motion_arc_root_note: right foot still owns the base; root begins to rise without erasing rear-load debt

keys.name: LEAD_TOE_REACQUIRE
keys.causal_role: lead toe probes at the new address after the rear leg has already arrested the impulse
keys.motion_arc_root_note: COM remains right-biased; toe contact is a test, not instant full re-ownership

keys.name: REBASE_PLANT_COUNTERTORQUE
keys.causal_role: new lead plant widens authority while pelvis counter-rotates before the collapsed guard can reopen
keys.motion_arc_root_note: both feet own floor at a displaced narrower address; upper body intentionally lags

keys.name: GUARD_REOPEN_LAG
keys.causal_role: root and support recover before the impact-side guard is allowed to reopen
keys.motion_arc_root_note: late arm recovery preserves visible phase debt after stance stability returns

keys.name: DISPLACED_READY_DEBT
keys.causal_role: recovery ends displaced with the impact-side hand still low and the stance re-authored rather than reset
keys.motion_arc_root_note: stable base returns at a different floor address; readiness debt remains in the left guard

tango_rounds.judgment: The threat is established before contact; K02 authors contact before maximum compression; the same left guard joint remains the contact owner while distal elbow fold leads shoulder/rib compression and only then pelvis/rear-load. Lead support does not peel until contact release. The right-only rear-load overshoot, unsupported lead rebase, toe probe, counter-torque, late guard reopening and displaced ready state remain visible without metadata. No contact migration, support teleport, reverse interpolation, equal-spacing mannequin reset, or decorative impact survives.

noodle_queen.taste: The compression wave gives the block a specific silhouette sentence: narrow early catch, increasingly folded rightward body, then a one-legged rear-load shape with the lead foot visibly detached.
noodle_queen.function: Incoming pressure, same-joint absorption, distal-to-proximal compliance, release-before-support-break, unilateral overshoot, rebase and late readiness all read in the actual render.
noodle_queen.contempt: It refuses the polite block-and-reset. The body keeps paying after the threat disappears, re-bases under debt, and leaves the impact-side guard late.
